key.description: The resource's identity, when that is not its path. Say it when you move the file: the path the resource had. It never changes.

path.description: The resource's path, when the file is kept somewhere that does not give it one.

description.description: What the dashboard is for, under its name.

refresh.description: How often an open dashboard reads its widgets again.

name.description: What the page's widgets name the filter by, and its key in the address.

label.description: What the reader sees above the filter. Left out, the name.

type.description: What is chosen: a stretch of days, a choice, a number or text.

default.description: What the filter holds until the reader changes it.

choices.description: The values a choice filter offers, when they are listed here.

from.description: The column a choice filter offers the values of, read as the reader may.

column.description: The column whose values are offered.

filters.description: What the reader narrows every widget by, above the dashboard.

id.description: Names the widget on its page: what an action and a filter point at.

type.description: The widget, by its pack and name, as core/chart.

title.description: The heading drawn on the widget. Left out, it has none.

at.description: Where it sits on the page's grid of twelve columns, and its size.

x.description: The column it starts at, from 0.

y.description: The row it starts at, from 0.

w.description: How many columns wide it is.

h.description: How many rows tall it is.

data.description: What the widget reads, by the name of each input its definition declares, read on the server as the reader may.

config.description: The widget's settings, checked against its definition's schema.

on.description: What happens when the widget raises an event (a row clicked, a point clicked): an action, by the event's name.

rules.description: When the widget is shown. Hiding a widget isn't security: the rows a person gets are decided by the tables' row rules.
